title.narrative: Water Management Project to increase water security through integrating nature based solutions & agricultural water management

description.narrative: This project aims to increase water security in MENA through integrating Resilient Nature Based Water Solutions and Agricultural Water Management in the face of climate change and land degradation. The project is developing action-oriented field demonstrations and recommendations to improve uptake and long-term sustainability of Resilient Nature Based Water Solutions/ Agricultural Water Management in Egypt, Jordan, Lebanon, and the OPTs.
